purpose: MyDancr logo concepts for review. These are not wired into the live site.

concepts.name: 01-violet-wordmark
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original MyDancr logo concept presentation.
Create a refined logo for MyDancr, a nightlife discovery website whose current visual identity is a lowercase white name with violet final r, near-black backgrounds and violet accents.
Text verbatim: "mydancr", seven lowercase letters m y d a n c r. Spell exactly; no extra text.
Direction: a beautifully drawn, bold geometric sans-serif wordmark, confident rounded letterforms, carefully balanced close kerning, a memorable custom final r that rises with a subtle forward-cut shoulder. The letters "mydanc" are near-white #f5f3ff and only the final "r" is vivid violet #7c3aed. Surround the wordmark with one fine violet rounded-rectangle outline reminiscent of the site's current logo, with ample interior padding and a restrained tiny break near the custom r. Very subtle violet light immediately at the frame edge only; keep letter edges flat and perfectly crisp.
Composition: one single large horizontal logo centered in a 3:2 landscape canvas with generous black margin. The logo occupies about 75% of width. Solid near-black #050507 backdrop.
Style: premium contemporary digital brand identity, simple scalable vector-like geometry, strong legibility on a mobile header. Do not include people, silhouettes, pole dancers, ornamental stars, crowns, gradients on text, 3D, photographs, mockup objects, explanatory captions, or watermarks.

concepts.name: 02-md-monogram
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original MyDancr logo concept presentation.
Design a distinctive original logo for MyDancr, a nightlife discovery and dancer profile platform. Match its site identity: violet #7c3aed, near-white #f5f3ff, solid near-black #050507.
Text verbatim: "mydancr", lowercase, spelled m y d a n c r. No tagline, no extra text.
Direction: a compact, ingenious geometric MD monogram at left, followed by a lowercase mydancr wordmark at right. The mark fuses a smooth lowercase m rhythm with a D-shaped outer curve in a single bold violet ribbon, using clean negative space; it should be readable and memorable at app-icon size, with a subtle sense of motion without arrows or swooshes. The icon is roughly the height of the wordmark plus 20%. Draw a custom rounded geometric sans-serif wordmark in near-white; final r in violet. Use clean kerning and a firm balanced baseline.
Composition: one horizontal centered lockup, icon and wordmark, ample breathing room, about 76% of the width of a 3:2 landscape canvas. Solid near-black backdrop.
Style: elite understated identity design, flat crisp vector-like construction, not a gaming logo. No surrounding frame, no decorative border, no glow, no gradients, no 3D, no stock dancing silhouettes, no crowns, no photography, no mockup objects, no labels or watermarks.

concepts.name: 03-live-location
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original MyDancr logo concept presentation.
Create an original MyDancr logo based on its nightlife discovery website: find dancers by city and see who is working now. The site is near-black with violet branding, white lowercase type, and green live indicators.
Text verbatim: "mydancr", exactly seven lowercase letters m y d a n c r. No other text.
Direction: a minimal distinctive violet location-pin symbol that subtly reads as a lowercase d through its negative-space center, paired with a crisp lowercase mydancr wordmark. Place one small solid emerald-green #34e3a4 live-status dot at the upper-right edge of the pin, separated by a tiny near-black gap. Keep the symbol geometric, thick, confident, recognizably a location mark but with a custom identity. Wordmark near-white #f5f3ff, bold clean modern sans serif with subtly rounded corners, final r vivid violet #7c3aed. Use violet for the icon; green only for the tiny live-status dot.
Composition: one large horizontal logo centered on a solid near-black #050507 background, pin left and wordmark right, well-balanced spacing, around 75% canvas width, 3:2 landscape canvas with generous margins.
Style: polished premium digital platform identity, flat vector-like forms readable at small sizes. Avoid hearts, map graphics, ornamental stars, people, pole dancers, stock swooshes, neon glow, 3D, texture, mockup objects, explanatory captions, watermarks.
